Entra Connect sync options:

  Password Hash Sync (PHS)
    - syncs a hash of the password hash
    - Entra ID validates sign-ins on its own

  Pass-through Authentication (PTA)
    - Entra ID forwards sign-in to an on-prem agent
    - password validation never leaves on-prem

  + Seamless SSO for domain-joined machines
caption: The on-prem AD account stays authoritative; Entra ID gets a synced hybrid identity.
